author: TheGreatandPowerfulTrixie
text_post: I think it says a lot about the problem when you see comments like this: "These people just distract from real men's issues. Like a much higher suicide rate, the drugging of American boys with adderal and Ritalin, and what it means to be a good man in today's ever complicated landscapes." As I replied, these are actually things MRAs are very much interested in. I'd say male suicide is one of the driving forces, with a lot of other issues being means to an end for that (you can't be concerned about suicide rates without being concerned with the causes of suicides). The drugging of boys has a lot to do with another big MRA issue, the way the western education system is failing boys. I also mentioned the issue of male victims of domestic violence and sexual abuse, and child custody, and said that all of these together are the primary issues MRAs wish to deal with. I admitted there are trivial issues too, but the same is very much true of feminism. The only difference is that MRAs trivial issues are not at the forefront and some of them are blow out of proportion by anti-MRAs, wheras a lot of modern, white-feminisms issues are primary issues for them.
